free_text: Deferring is appropriate because the patient has a prior positive biopsy, meaning the diagnosis is already established, and the retrieved documents do not provide a compelling reason to re-sample. The PI-RADS 3 finding and rising PSA trend are not sufficient to mandate further tissue sampling when a prior diagnosis exists. The room converged on deferral because the prior positive biopsy status was noted as a critical factor by the cohort study.
